title: Neil Armstrong seemed scared at his speech after the moon landing

tellings.quote: Neil Armstrong comes back. He gives a speech three weeks afterwards and he's giving the speech and he he looks kind of he goes this is a big step for mankind and he looks very kind of scared and sheepish

plain: In 1969, about three weeks after coming back from the Moon, the astronaut Neil Armstrong gave a speech, the first man to walk on the Moon talking about "a big step for mankind". Michels says Armstrong looked scared and sheepish while he spoke. Michels describes this himself, without naming a source, as a hint that Armstrong may have seen something up there that troubled him.
